info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Molybd Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Molybd Notebook Details Management API enables users to create and manage detailed records of Molybd notebooks within the catalog. This endpoint supports the submission of new notebook details, facilitating the addition of specifications, features, and other important metadata. Ideal for catalog managers and inventory systems, this API streamlines the process of updating product information to ensure accuracy and completeness. It is essential for businesses looking to maintain an up-to-date and comprehensive catalog, enhancing the overall customer experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for a Molybd notebook. It accepts the required data in the request body to populate the notebook details accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit detailed information about the Molybd Notebook. It must contain the necessary fields required for the creation or update of the notebook details.

200.description: The request was successful and the response contains the requested details.

CreateCatalogMolybdNotebookDetailRequest.title: Molybd Notebook Operations Request Body

molybd_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier for the Molybd notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the requested notebook.

CreateCatalogMolybdNotebookDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for operations related to the Molybd notebook. It includes details such as the notebook ID, requester information, desired quantity, priority status, and unit price.

CreateCatalogMolybdNotebookDetailRespons.title: Response for Operations POST

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the created or modified record.

processedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the operation criteria.

CreateCatalogMolybdNotebookDetailRespons.description: This schema represents the response structure for a successful POST request to the operations endpoint.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the response content. For example, 'application/json' indicates that the response body contains JSON data.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value helps in understanding the performance of the operation.
